summary: Iteration 42 - CallInterface Dark Mode & Mobile Responsiveness Testing Complete. Code review verified all requirements: (1) Dark-native design with bg-[#0f1729], bg-[#131b2e], bg-[#0a0f1c] backgrounds, (2) All buttons use bg-white/15 for visibility against dark background, (3) Mute button red when muted, (4) End call button always visible with red-600 and shadow-red-600/30, (5) Hold button amber when on hold, (6) Video toggle blue when enabled, (7) Screen share and record hidden on mobile (hidden sm:flex) with More menu fallback, (8) Mobile responsive h-12/h-14 sizing with gap-2/gap-3. Fixed missing safe-bottom CSS class for mobile notch support.
critical_code_review_comments: CallInterface.jsx line 66: Dark-native design correctly uses bg-[#0f1729] for main container - always dark regardless of app theme
CallInterface.jsx lines 127-177: All control buttons use raw HTML buttons with explicit bg-white/15 for visibility - no longer using Shadcn Button 'outline' variant
CallInterface.jsx lines 144-154: Screen share and record buttons have 'hidden sm:flex' class - hidden on mobile, visible on sm+ screens
CallInterface.jsx lines 167-168: Mobile users can access Screen Share and Record via More dropdown menu with 'sm:hidden' class
CallInterface.jsx line 175: End call button has shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 for extra visibility
CallInterface.jsx line 125: Responsive gap spacing - gap-2 on mobile, gap-3 on desktop (sm:gap-3)
index.css: Added missing .safe-bottom CSS class with env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for mobile notch support
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 42 verified CallInterface dark mode and mobile responsiveness. The call interface cannot be tested in headless browser due to microphone/camera requirements - 'Could not access microphone/camera' error is expected. Code review confirms all UI requirements are met. The safe-bottom CSS class was missing and has been added to index.css for mobile notch support.

dark_native_design.details: bg-[#0f1729] main container, bg-[#131b2e] video area, bg-[#0a0f1c] controls - always dark regardless of app theme

button_visibility.details: All buttons use bg-white/15 with hover:bg-white/25 - visible against dark background

mute_button.details: Red (bg-red-600) when muted, bg-white/15 when unmuted - always visible

end_call_button.details: bg-red-600 with shadow-lg shadow-red-600/30 - always visible, no hidden class

hold_button.details: Amber (bg-amber-600) when on hold, bg-white/15 otherwise

mobile_hidden_buttons.details: Screen share and record have 'hidden sm:flex' - hidden on mobile, available in More menu

responsive_sizing.details: h-12 w-12 on mobile, sm:h-14 sm:w-14 on desktop, gap-2 sm:gap-3

sip_badge.details: SIP badge shows in header when activeCall.call_type === 'sip'

call_status_badge.details: Badge shows Connecting.../On Hold/connected status with appropriate colors

data_testid_attributes.details: All key buttons have data-testid: call-interface, call-mute-btn, call-video-btn, call-hold-btn, call-screenshare-btn, call-record-btn, call-end-btn

safe_bottom_padding.details: Added missing .safe-bottom CSS class to index.css with env(safe-area-inset-bottom)
